title: Stasis Radio Flyer
description: A man in a purple suit sits in a red Radio Flyer wagon pulled by glowing blue energy orbs along a path of red cards, while a woman in a pink and black gothic dress stands on church steps taking a selfie with a glowing smartphone. Behind them is a decaying gothic church labeled STASIS with a heron on the roof, surrounded by a dark swampy forest under a colorful twilight sky.
prompt: A man in a purple suit and sunglasses sits inside a red Radio Flyer wagon being pulled by glowing blue energy orbs along a path lined with red cards, while a gothic woman in a pink and black dress with spiked hair takes a glowing smartphone selfie on the steps of a decaying gothic church labeled STASIS. A blue heron perches on the roof, purple energy tendrils swirl through the air, skeleton figures walk in the background, dark swampy forest with hanging moss and a dramatic twilight sky.
